title: Fixed-Price Energy Line Corrections for the Pass-Through Cycle - C&I
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - correcting the fixed-price energy line of the pass-through cycle.**

A fixed-price line correction returns what the fixed-price energy line of the pass-through cycle, which is its block energy charge line on a block and index contract or its energy charge line on a fixed structure, was billed above the price in force for that cycle, the pass-through cycle being the cycle that began on the stated effective date of the contract's latest regulatory pass-through notice; it is posted, when the business disputes the line, as one rebill credit tied to that line through its reference number, and only when the over-billed amount is positive.

The latest regulatory pass-through notice is the one with the latest notice date among the contract's notices.

## Posting the credit: `credit_fixed_price_line_5b24cf0d`

The agent unlocks `credit_fixed_price_line_5b24cf0d` and then calls it.

**Capability.** One call posts a rebill credit against one fixed-price energy bill line of a commercial and industrial electricity contract (a block energy line on a block and index contract, or a fixed energy line on a fixed structure) that the business disputes as billed above the price in force for its cycle. It adds one rebill credit line, dated today, to the same contract's bill, tied to the disputed line and dated to that line's billing cycle; the net charges billed on the contract fall by the credited amount, and the credit then appears among the contract's bill lines. The disputed line itself is not changed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `source_billing_id` | the reference number of the disputed fixed-price energy bill line, as shown on the bill lines returned by the C&I bill lookup | bill line reference |
| `amount_usd` | the rebill credit | US dollars, a negative number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_billing_id` (the reference number of the new rebill credit line), `source_billing_id` (the line corrected), `cni_contract_id` (the contract credited), `line_type`, always `rebill_credit`, `billing_period_start` (the corrected line's cycle, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount_usd` (negative, 2 decimal places) and `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Which line is corrected

| Structure of the contract | Fixed-price energy line of the pass-through cycle |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | the block energy charge line of that cycle |
| a fixed structure | the energy charge line of that cycle |
